# bugs #2948: An anonymous struct in a union, or in braces of its own, gets only its first member initialized

- Ticket: https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/bugs/2948/
- Category: [Fixes that need a decision](../../fix-decision.md)
- Evidence: tested on r17193
- Recommended action: Confirm the reading of braces under Decision. Apply after the patch for #3121 and close.
- Patch: [bugs-2948.patch](../../patches/bugs-2948.patch), commit [`e9a706145`](https://github.com/mdmower/sdcc/commit/e9a706145e031c026eba837c5b9279c6cf1d02fa). Apply after `bugs-3121.patch`.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

A union whose first member is an anonymous struct takes only the first member of that struct from
its initializer. `gcc-torture-execute-pr87053.c` has this case under `#if 0`. It was reproduced
for mcs51 in all models, in the data image and in the code that initializes automatic objects.

A second fault has the same cause. Braces around the initializers of an anonymous struct or union
are read as braces around the initializer of its first member. For the list `{1, {2, 3}, 4}` and
`struct S { char p; struct { char a; char b; }; char q; }` the compiler discards 3 and assigns 4
to `b` without a diagnostic.

## Cause

`promoteAnonStructs` in `src/SDCCsymt.c` replaces an anonymous struct or union by its members in
the member list of the type that contains it. That list has no record of where the anonymous
struct or union starts and ends. `printIvalStruct` in `src/SDCCglue.c` and `createIvalStruct` in
`src/SDCCast.c` initialize a union through the first member of the list only.

## Fix

`promoteAnonStructs` marks the first and the last member of each anonymous struct or union. The
new `unbraceAnonIlist` in `src/SDCCval.c` replaces a list in braces for an anonymous struct or
union by the elements of that list, with one `INIT_HOLE` entry for each member that the braces
omit. `reorderIlistFull` calls it for the data image. `designatedIlist`, which the patch for #3121
adds, calls it for objects that code initializes. `printIvalStruct` processes a union whose first
alternative has several members like a struct, and `createIvalStruct` continues after the first
member of a union.

## Decision

SDCC has no brace elision for array and struct members. Without the patch, braces at the position
of an anonymous struct or union whose first member is an array or a struct are always that
member's own braces. `bracesAnonGroup` keeps this reading when the list in the braces starts with
a plain expression. It assigns the braces to the anonymous struct or union when the list starts
with another brace, with a designator for one of its members, or with a string literal for an
array. ISO C assigns the braces to the anonymous struct or union in every case. With the ISO rule
and without brace elision the compiler would reject `{1, {2, 3}, 4}` for `struct W` of the test,
whose anonymous union starts with a named struct.

The patch changes three diagnostics. Excess initializers inside the braces of an anonymous struct
or union get warning 147 with the name of its last member. A designator inside such braces that
names a member outside of them gets error 202, and without the patch the compiler accepts it. In
the data image, an excess initializer for a union that starts with an anonymous struct gets no
warning 147, because such a union is processed like a struct.

## Verification

`support/regression/tests/bug-2948.c` has constant and automatic objects, nested anonymous
structs, lists that omit members, and designators inside the braces. The patch also removes the
`#if 0` lines from `gcc-torture-execute-pr87053.c`. Both tests fail for mcs51 without the source
change. With this patch and the one for #3121 they pass on the host, for mcs51 in the four models
and with `--stack-auto`, for stm8, and for z80. The regression suite for mcs51-small and valdiag
for mcs51 have no failures, and no other test changes its code size.

## Related

- The patch for #3121 adds `designatedIlist`, which this patch changes.
- With this patch, a positional initializer after a designator for an alternative of an anonymous
  union other than the first is assigned to a wrong member, in the data image and in code.
- With this patch, for `union V` of the test in automatic storage, `{{1, .c = 4}}` sets `b`.
